name: @tangen/realtime-react
description: React bindings for @tangen/realtime - a provider, useRealtime, useRealtimeStatus, useRealtimeEvent, usePresence and usePresenceSelector. Selector-based, so a component re-renders only when its slice changes; never a second transport.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
